Package com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry

Enum Class GObjectRegistry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<GObjectRegistry>
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GObjectRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<GObjectRegistry>, Constable
public enum GObjectRegistry extends Enum<GObjectRegistry>
Defines the main registry for checking for GObjects, primarily used by these subsystems:
  • CommandParser/TaggedArgUtil /Command/TypingHints for command parsing, usage parsing, typed hints and etc
  • PropertiesUI for showing properties of these objects
  • And overall just decentralisation of making these objects.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • tHintsUsageStringTypeMatch

      public static boolean tHintsUsageStringTypeMatch(String letters)
      Checks if the given string matches a specific pattern derived from the simple name of a registered GObject. The pattern is formed by repeating the first two characters of the simple name twice (e.g., "curve" -> "cucu", "line" -> "lili"). This is primarily used for typing hints in command line interfaces.
      Parameters:
      letters - The string to match.
      Returns:
      true if the string matches the pattern for any registered GObject, false otherwise.
      See Also:
